## Change summary

Describe the change and link the requested work.

## Verification

- [ ] Automatic checks pass for this exact revision.
- [ ] No credentials, encryption keys, database exports or real client records are included.
- [ ] QA tested using synthetic data; screenshots/results attached where appropriate.

## Production promotion only

- QA candidate version and commit:
- Client approval reference, approver and date:
- Test result link:
- Database migration compatibility / backup reference (no secrets):
- Previous compatible release for rollback:

- [ ] Client approval applies to the exact tested revision.
- [ ] Production hosting, HTTPS/API routing, secrets, uploads and restore procedure are verified.
- [ ] No automatic database restore or destructive migration is part of rollback.

Merging a branch is not permission to expose secrets or bypass deployment approval.
